incidents.name: Will trading settles expired orders at pool spot price
incidents.notes: settleExpiredPositions() settles a placeSellOrder() position at the WILL/USDT PancakeSwap spot price, so the attacker placed an order, bought 88,000 USDT of WILL to move the pool and settled at the manipulated rate.

sources.ref: onchain review: victim 0x566777eD780dbbe17c130AE97b9FbC0A3Ab829DF created 2024-06-25T10:52:51Z by 0xac016cb9dc0b28e0a93502a2ac69b12e8b217c34, which is not the attack-tx sender 0xb6911dee6a5b1c65ad1ac11a99aec09c2cf83c0e; 0 EIP-1967 Upgraded events on the victim before the incident; code age measured from deployment (onchain).
